Role.name: Vink Care Agent
Role.Description: Customer care agents: create and work tickets, claims and customers. No deletes. Assign together with Basic User.

Role.name: Vink Care Manager
Role.Description: Customer care managers: everything a Care Agent can do plus delete, reassign and share tickets, and manage teams, products and orders. Assign together with Basic User.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - RMA Process
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: verifies warranty from the order serial number, creates the warranty claim, service ticket and courier booking, and emails the return label (test mailbox).

Description.description: Agent flow: verifies warranty from the order serial number, creates the warranty claim, service ticket and courier booking, and emails the return label (test mailbox).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Repair Update
Workflow.Description: Agent flow used by the autonomous trigger: reads the service ticket after the warehouse scan, records the repair result, updates the ticket status and emails the customer (test mailbox).

Description.description: Agent flow used by the autonomous trigger: reads the service ticket after the warehouse scan, records the repair result, updates the ticket status and emails the customer (test mailbox).

Workflow.Name: Warehouse scan received
Workflow.Description: Trigger your agent with certain message upon event: When a row is added, modified or deleted.

Description.description: Trigger your agent with certain message upon event: When a row is added, modified or deleted.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Find Customer
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: finds a customer by email and verifies them with an order number or customer number. Returns status (Verified, NotVerified, NeedVerification, NotFound, Error), their details and open tickets.

Description.description: Agent flow: finds a customer by email and verifies them with an order number or customer number. Returns status (Verified, NotVerified, NeedVerification, NotFound, Error), their details and open tickets.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Register Customer
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: registers a new customer (Contact) with an auto customer number and sends a welcome email. Returns status (Created, Exists, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: registers a new customer (Contact) with an auto customer number and sends a welcome email. Returns status (Created, Exists, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - List Customer Orders
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: returns a verified customer's orders, newest first, as a list and as choices (ORDER~label separated by |) for an adaptive card.

Description.description: Agent flow: returns a verified customer's orders, newest first, as a list and as choices (ORDER~label separated by |) for an adaptive card.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - List Customer Tickets
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: returns a verified customer's tickets (open only, or all), newest first, as a list and as choices for an adaptive card.

Description.description: Agent flow: returns a verified customer's tickets (open only, or all), newest first, as a list and as choices for an adaptive card.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Create Ticket
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: creates a service ticket for a verified customer. Routes it to a team by category, sets SLA times from priority (VIP customers get at least High), links the order, and refuses duplicates (same customer, order and category still open) unless AllowDuplicate is yes. Returns result (Created, Duplicate, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: creates a service ticket for a verified customer. Routes it to a team by category, sets SLA times from priority (VIP customers get at least High), links the order, and refuses duplicates (same customer, order and category still open) unless AllowDuplicate is yes. Returns result (Created, Duplicate, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Get Ticket Details
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: returns a ticket's status, team, SLA, latest update and customer-visible timeline, only if it belongs to the verified customer. Returns result (Found, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: returns a ticket's status, team, SLA, latest update and customer-visible timeline, only if it belongs to the verified customer. Returns result (Found, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Add Customer Reply
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: adds the customer's message to their ticket timeline. A ticket that was Awaiting customer or Resolved moves back to In progress. Closed tickets are refused. Returns result (Added, Closed, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: adds the customer's message to their ticket timeline. A ticket that was Awaiting customer or Resolved moves back to In progress. Closed tickets are refused. Returns result (Added, Closed, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Escalate Ticket
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: escalates the customer's ticket to a person: sets status Escalated, logs the reason on the timeline and emails the support mailbox (environment variable CC Support Mailbox). Returns result (Escalated, Closed, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: escalates the customer's ticket to a person: sets status Escalated, logs the reason on the timeline and emails the support mailbox (environment variable CC Support Mailbox). Returns result (Escalated, Closed, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Record CSAT
Workflow.Description: Agent flow: saves the customer's 1-5 satisfaction rating and comment on a resolved or closed ticket; scores of 2 or less alert the support mailbox. Returns result (Saved, NotResolved, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Description.description: Agent flow: saves the customer's 1-5 satisfaction rating and comment on a resolved or closed ticket; scores of 2 or less alert the support mailbox. Returns result (Saved, NotResolved, NotFound, NotYours, Error).

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Ticket Created
Workflow.Description: Automated: when a service ticket is created, routes it to a team by category, fills SLA times from priority if missing, logs "Ticket created" on the timeline, emails the customer a confirmation (not for warranty RMA tickets, which get a return label) and alerts the support mailbox for High/Urgent or VIP tickets.

Description.description: Automated: when a service ticket is created, routes it to a team by category, fills SLA times from priority if missing, logs "Ticket created" on the timeline, emails the customer a confirmation (not for warranty RMA tickets, which get a return label) and alerts the support mailbox for High/Urgent or VIP tickets.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Ticket Status Changed
Workflow.Description: Automated: when a service ticket's status changes (from the agent, a flow or Vink Care Hub), logs the change on the customer timeline, stamps Resolved on, and emails the customer the new status with the latest update. Resolved tickets ask for a CSAT rating.

Description.description: Automated: when a service ticket's status changes (from the agent, a flow or Vink Care Hub), logs the change on the customer timeline, stamps Resolved on, and emails the customer the new status with the latest update. Resolved tickets ask for a CSAT rating.

Workflow.Name: Customer Care - Daily SLA Check
Workflow.Description: Scheduled daily at 03:00 UTC (08:30 IST): flags tickets past their Resolve by time as Overdue, closes tickets Awaiting customer for 7+ days and Resolved tickets older than 7 days, and emails the support mailbox an overdue report.

Description.description: Scheduled daily at 03:00 UTC (08:30 IST): flags tickets past their Resolve by time as Overdue, closes tickets Awaiting customer for 7+ days and Resolved tickets older than 7 days, and emails the support mailbox an overdue report.
